mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate investment and consumption, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 8% signals labor market weakness, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when UNRATE exceeds 8%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent weakness in both unemployment rate and payroll employment indicates a struggling labor market, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases when both proxies indicate labor market weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in industrial production growth during a late-cycle expansion may signal supply-side constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns remain positive despite slowing industrial production growth during late-cycle periods.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand in the housing market, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when housing starts increase (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in industrial production above its historical average may indicate supply chain pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO exceeds the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates combined with low real consumer spending indicate tight monetary conditions, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases when both proxies indicate tight monetary conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in GDP growth during a monetary tightening cycle may indicate reduced aggregate demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns remain positive despite slowing GDP growth during monetary tightening periods.
